item.title: Mapping primary violence prevention activity across the Humber
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-07T12:00:00Z
Colleagues from our Violence Prevention Partnership (VPP) are looking for a suitable provider to map violence prevention activity across the Humber region. The mapping should incorporate and distinguish between explicit violence prevention programmes and wider provision with a plausible but indirect preventative contribution, such as on behaviours which may escalate into violence. It should include reference to core national standards and expectations (for example, the PSHE curriculum) and take a proportionate approach to understanding how this is implemented locally. Full details are provided in the attached specification.

item.title: RFQ 2026/47 - Kilcurry Subcatchment Targeted River & Catchment Assessment
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 19,550 Status: active Deadline: 2026-11-28T12:00:00Z
NMDDC wishes to appoint a suitably qualified environmental consultancy to undertake a targeted assessment of the Forkhill River and Cully River within the Northern Ireland section of the Kilcurry Subcatchment.
